title: Etsy Scraper: Search, Shops, Listings & Reviews
h1: Etsy scraper: pick the right tool for your job
metaDescription: Three Etsy scrapers cover search results, whole shops, and single listings with buyer reviews. Public data, no Etsy login or API key. Export JSON or CSV.
intro: Etsy data comes in three shapes, and each scraper starts from a different link: a search or category (Etsy Search Scraper), a shop (Etsy Shop Scraper), or a listing (Etsy Reviews Scraper, which also returns buyer reviews). All three read public pages, so you need no Etsy login or API key.

chooser.start: A keyword, category or search link
chooser.want: Every matching listing with price, shop and rating

chooser.start: A shop URL, name or ID
chooser.want: The shop profile and its whole catalog
Full listing details and buyer reviews

faq.q: Do I need an Etsy API key?
faq.a: No. Etsy's Open API v3 needs a registered app and a key; these scrapers read public Etsy pages, so a link or a keyword is enough.

faq.q: Which Etsy scraper should I start with?
faq.a: Start from what you have. A keyword: Etsy Search Scraper. A competitor shop: Etsy Shop Scraper. A product you want reviews for: Etsy Reviews Scraper.
Yes. A common chain is search first, then send the shops you found to the shop scraper, or the best listings to the reviews scraper.
